text: {"tasks":[{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Query and quantify EU refund totals and counts by month for June and July 2026 to confirm the magnitude of the increase."},{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Break down July 2026 EU refunds by country, product category, and refund reason code to identify which segments drove the increase versus June."},{"role":"sql_analyst","objective":"Investigate correlated factors such as order volume, return policy changes, product launches, or shipping/quality issues in the EU during June-July 2026 that could explain the refund spike."},{"role":"evaluator","objective":"Assess whether the sql_analyst's findings sufficiently and accurately explain the root cause of the EU refund increase from June to July 2026."},{"role":"orchestrator","objective":"Synthesize the validated findings into a clear causal explanation and summary answer for why EU refunds increased from June to July 2026."}]}
